name: Basic Form 2
source: Toni Kennerson, school sheet (Basic Form Two.docx via /workspace/katas/basic-form-2.md)
senseiLine: Practice your kata with your instructor.

steps.text: Step forward w/RF, pivot on the balls of feet, face L w/RF in rear, LH downward block (protect (L) front leg) w/RH chambered on R hip, return LH to L hip (chamber). RF reverse straight forward kick w/RF landing forward, LH reverse punch, RH straight forward punch

Raise RH fist (across body) to L ear, look over R shoulder then 180- degree turn w/RF leading, end facing R w/RF forward, followed by RH downward block (over RL) w/LH chambered on L hip, return RH to R hip (chamber). LF reverse straight forward kick w/LF landing forward, RH reverse punch, LH straightforward punch

Raise LH fist (across body) to R ear, while (short) stepping to rear w/RF into cat stance, step forward w/LF, LH downward block (over LL), RH chambered on R hip. Bring LH across body (between waist & chest high) and place LH (fist) on top of RH (fist) performing a Catch on the R hip. RF reverse kick w/ RF landing forward followed by RH straight forward punch. Bring RH across body (between waist & chest high) and place RH (fist) on top of LH (fist) performing a Catch on the L hip. LF reverse kick w/ LF landing forward followed by LH straight forward punch. Bring LH across body (between waist & chest high) and place LH (fist) on top of RH (fist) performing a Catch on the R hip. RF reverse kick w/ RF landing forward followed by RH straight forward punch. (kiai)
question: Q12

steps.text: With LF step (behind) 180-degrees now facing L w/LF forward, face L w/RF in rear, LH downward block (protect (L) front leg) w/RH chambered on R hip, return LH to L hip (chamber). RF reverse straight forward kick w/RF landing forward, LH reverse punch, RH straight forward punch
steps.jayNote: Correct as written: LF = left foot forward, RF = right foot in rear (Jay, Oct 24).
